steps.text: Abandoned Mansion, Londinium Outskirts

steps.name: Nervous Soldier
steps.text: Is she back?

steps.name: Unhappy Soldier
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Nervous Soldier
steps.text: Damn, it was hard enough dodging those devils. How did she survive and even find us—

steps.name: Nervous Soldier
steps.text: How the heck did she know that I did business with the devils?

steps.name: Unhappy Soldier
steps.text: Well, consider that business deal lost.

steps.name: Nervous Soldier
steps.text: What about you? How'd she get you?

steps.name: Unhappy Soldier
steps.text: She held a crossbow to my head.

steps.name: Unhappy Soldier
steps.text: I knew her from before. She didn't used to be so—
Didn't used to be so what?
Go on.

steps.name: Unhappy Soldier
steps.text: Er, no, I didn't—
The soldier, who has served the dukes all his life, lies on the ground, a crossbow pointed at his forehead.
The voice of the one holding the crossbow is cold as ice.
I'm waiting.

steps.name: Terrified Soldier
steps.text: I just—s-sorry, Millscar!

steps.name: Terrified Soldier
steps.text: I-I shouldn't have—

steps.name: Terrified Soldier
steps.text: Aaaahh!
The bolt pierces his ear.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Some people punch holes in their pets' ears as a sign of ownership.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: A man is not a pet, of course... but sometimes they're not so different, are they?

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Now get back up and give me a status report.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Have you done what I've asked of you?

steps.name: Terrified Soldier
steps.text: Y-Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Terrified Soldier
steps.text: W-well, the reception at the monitoring station was really bad, so even though we tried to gather as much information as possible—

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Skip to the conclusion.

steps.name: Terrified Soldier
steps.text: Based on what little information the Trilby Asher left behind, and the occasional intercepted comms, we can confirm that a unit called 'the Exemplars' has been formed, and its leader is most likely the one you spoke of...

steps.name: Terrified Soldier
steps.text: 'Vina'.

steps.name: Terrified Soldier
steps.text: They seem to be headed for the front at Silverrock Bluffs.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Silverrock Bluffs. They're really staying in this war.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Keep at it. Notify me of any new developments.

steps.name: Terrified Soldier
steps.text: Y-Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: —Phew.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Well, this is easier than expected.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: I thought it would be tougher.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: No scruples. No acts to put up.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: I found Victoria.
A red light flashes a few times in the deep shadows.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Isn't it your job to protect her?
Forty-three hours into the operation...

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: I knew you would come.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Ulšulah.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: That mad bomber W came once to set up this prison.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Ines came twice to show 'compassion'. Same old Ines, always a tad slow with her retort when she's focused on someone else's shadow.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Now, it's you. What have you come to say?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Have you thought it over?

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: That's my line.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Your situation is perilous. Your only vehicle lies disabled.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: As the pilot, I'm very likely to know something that you don't, and probably am waiting for the right time to strike.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Really, you should kill me, Hoederer.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I would rather you helped us with what you know.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: In your dreams.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: I already turned you down once. You give me too little credit if you think I would change my mind just because I'm a prisoner.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Three times.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You saved our lives three times back in Kazdel. My life once, Ines's life twice.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: You wrote all that in your diary?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Name your price. I'll do my best to pay it.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: You'll go bankrupt if you quit the mercenary life to open a business.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I just want as many Sarkaz to make it back to Kazdel alive as possible.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Such grand ambitions.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: But enough chitchat. Let the old rules of Scar Market lie buried beneath Kazdel. Our debt is settled.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: One last warning, Hoederer. Kill me now, or you'll regret it.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Did it ever occur to you that we both want the same thing—

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Enough of your righteous crap.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Don't try to buy my life with your flowery words, old friend. They're not much better than money.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: A mercenary takes no sides. But you and I aren't really mercenaries anymore.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wanna bet, Ines?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hoederer's gonna try talking Ulšulah into helping for old time's sake at Scar Market. Ulšulah's gonna tell him to just get it over with, and Hoederer's gonna come back with a long face.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What's the wager?

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's it? I figured you'd be jealous with the two of them all alone in a room together.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Stop trying to read my shadow, Ines. I'm not in the mood.

steps.name: W
steps.text: The bunny and the Victorian have been gone for a while... wonder how things are going out there.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Bonesy is still playing dead, and Theresis's Catastrophe refuses to go away. Who knows, maybe Manfred's gonna just pop out of nowhere.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I could have blown Theresis up right then and there!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I know you're restless because of Theresa, but hold that fuse for a moment. We have a lot of prep work to do.

steps.name: W
steps.text: *Sarkaz swearing*! Who said I was—

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: We've got a problem, W...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Out with it.

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: It's time for a shift change, but not all our scouts came back.

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: Crane's team went off to the north side of the canyon, and we can't reach them.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't tell me they ran into a decent enemy caster.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: When was your last communication?

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: Almost three hours ago.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: If our enemy could make an entire merc squad disappear without a sound, they would've been on top of us by now.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The most important thing to do at the moment is keep the Lifebone safe.

steps.name: W
steps.text: We're just gonna sit here when we know something's going on outside?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: I agree with Ines.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: We know nothing about this place. The safest course of action is to concentrate our forces.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Cut the crap. My men are missing. I want to know why.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If they got lost, I'll bring them back. If somebody did them in, I'll return the favor.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Calm down! This could be a trap to split us up—

steps.name: W
steps.text: I don't like playing defense. Even if it's a trap, I'll just blast them out of hiding.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Give me half a day. If I don't come back, that means I'm up against a real nasty piece of work. Don't come after me, get your defenses ready.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you get a call from Amiya, don't wait for me, just activate the Lifebone.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'll take my own squad. No need to bother anyone else.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You lot. Grab your weapons and follow me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Is this where they went?

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: Should be. This cave was all we saw when we went north into the canyon. We don't know what's inside.

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: Hidden passage? The court's secret cache?

steps.name: W
steps.text: If this was a secret base of the Royal Court, we'd have had a couple hundred Vampires and Nachzehrers on our asses the moment we fell in here.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Based on Closure's intel, we're in the hills to the west of Londinium, a good distance from the main battlefield where those old farts are.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Somehow, though, I smell... (sniffs)

steps.name: W
steps.text: The old, moldy stench from someone who's been here for ages.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I don't like old stuff, but I'm sure Hoederer would love it.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Let me guess. What enemy did our lucky winners run into?

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: W, when did you use your bombs?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You delusional? Did you see me use them on our way here?

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: Then what are these burn marks on the wall?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Strange. No sign of Arts, but how do you leave marks like these on stone, then?

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: Did you hear that?!

steps.name: W
steps.text: What is it this time?

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: It's the sound of someone striking iron... there's somebody here!

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're just hearing things.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Stop spooking yourself. Nobody's here.

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: Do we keep going, W? I have a bad feeling about this.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Of course. Why do you think we're here?

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's top-grade gear you all are using. I'm not rich enough to just let them rot in some cave.

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: Have you heard the Sarkaz legend... before Qui'lon was even born, the Sarkaz and a red dragon—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: W
steps.text: One historian in Hoederer is enough. Say anymore, and I'll throw you to the front—

steps.name: W Squad Member
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Blood... but not Sarkaz.

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's fresh—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Get ready to fight!
*Roar*—!
